examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, araññ'āyatane mahāsarasī. taṃ nāgā upanissāya viharanti. te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.

64601.meaning1: easily understood; easily recognized; easily known

examples.text: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.

64602.meaning1: easy to be taught; easily instructible; educatable
64602.commentary: (MNa) ye kathitakāraṇaṃ sallakkhenti, sukhena sakkā honti viññāpetuṃ, te suviññāpayā.

examples.text: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparaj'akkhe mahāraj'akkhe, tikkh'indriye mud'indriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app'ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, app'ekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.

64604.meaning1: well brushed; well plucked; (comm) well cleaned

examples.text: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha

64605.meaning1: well known; completely understood; fully comprehended

examples.text: sambhavā suviditā asārakā, saṅkhatā pacalitā sad'eritā, taṃ viditvā m'aham'attasambhavaṃ, santim'eva satimā samajjhagan'ti.
ahañ'hi, bhante, rathiko saññāto kusalo rathassa aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ. sabbāni me rathassa aṅgapaccaṅgāni suviditāni. ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ maṃ paṭibhāseyyā'ti.

64606.meaning1: very far away; a great distance away

64608.meaning1: extremely far away; a very great distance away
64608.commentary: (ANa) suvidūravidūrānī'ti kenaci pariyāyena anāsannāni hutvā suvidūrān'eva vidūrāni.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? nabhañ'ca, bhikkhave, pathavī ca, idaṃ paṭhamaṃ suvidūravidūre. orimañ'ca, bhikkhave, tīraṃ samuddassa pārimañ'ca, idaṃ dutiyaṃ suvidūravidūre.

64609.commentary: (MNa) suvidehānan'ti gaṅgāya orime tīre magadharaṭṭhaṃ, pārime tīre videharaṭṭhaṃ, gāvo magadharaṭṭhato videharaṭṭhaṃ netvā rakkhissāmī'ti uttaraṃ tīraṃ patāresi.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, māgadhako gopālako duppaññajātiko, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye, asamavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ, asamavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, atitthen'eva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
ubhayāni kho pana me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.

64611.meaning1: well trained; well disciplined; well educated (in)

examples.text: idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati
ko nu kho, bho, pahoti imaṃ mahāpathaviṃ uttarena āyataṃ dakkhiṇena sakaṭamukhaṃ sattadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitun'ti
ubhayāni kho pana me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.

64614.meaning1: well divided inside; evenly separated within

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, mahāpurisassa heṭṭhāpādatalesu cakkāni jātāni honti sahass'ārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni suvibhatt'antarāni.

64615.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of vibhatta
64615.construction:
su + vi + √bhaj + ta + aṃ
suvibhatta + aṃ

examples.text: evaṃ, bho'ti kho doṇo brāhmaṇo tesaṃ saṅghānaṃ gaṇānaṃ paṭissutvā bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitvā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca, imaṃ me bhonto tumbaṃ dadantu aham'pi tumbassa thūpañ'ca mahañ'ca karissāmī'ti. adaṃsu kho te doṇassa brāhmaṇassa tumbaṃ.

64616.meaning1: thoroughly freed; correctly liberated; perfectly emancipated
64616.notes: five vimutti 1. vikkhambhanavimutti, 2. tadaṅgavimutti, 3. samucchedavimutti, 4. paṭippassaddhivimutti, 5. nissaraṇavimutti

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā. ye suvimuttā, te kevalino. ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.
etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

64617.meaning1: with well liberated mind; with completely free heart

examples.text: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

64620.meaning1: well perfumed; well oiled; well anointed

examples.text: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu odātavatthavasano, atha kho so dubbaṇṇo'va hoti kodh'ābhibhūto.
idāni te, bhante, taṃ rajojallaṃ pavāhetvā sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū odātavatthā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāressantī'ti.
idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha

tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ kāmehi, ye ca kāmapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati. idam'akkhātaṃ kāmānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.

64624.meaning1: well cleansed; perfectly purified; completely pure

examples.text: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca, kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti?
yāvakīvañ'ca me, bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādas'ākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,

64625.meaning1: well cleansed; perfectly purified; completely pure

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bhante, sālalaṭṭhi bahiddhā suparikammakatā, anto suvisuddhakatā phiy'ārittabaddhā.
sudhotaṃ rajaken'āhan'ti vatthadhovakena purisena suṭṭhu dhovitaṃ suvisuddhakataṃ, uttareyyapaṭaṃ mama uttarasāṭakaṃ ahaṃ veḷagge laggitvā dhajaṃ katvā ukkhipiṃ, ambare ākāse ussāpesin'ti attho.
laddhāna manussakaṃ bhavaṃ tato caviya, puna sukataphalavipākasesakena, paṭilabhati lapanajaṃ samama'pi, suci ca suvisuddhasusukkaṃ.
tam'enaṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle chetvā agge chindeyya, agge chetvā sākhāpalāsaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya, sākhāpalāsaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā kuṭhārīhi taccheyya, kuṭhārīhi tacchetvā vāsīhi taccheyya
so yā tā sālalaṭṭhiyo kuṭilā oj'āpaharaṇiyo tā chetvā bahiddhā nīhareyya, antovanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya. yā pana tā sālalaṭṭhiyo ujukā sujātā tā sammā parihareyya.

64629.meaning1: fact of being well cleaned; fact of being thoroughly removed

examples.text: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

64630.commentary: (MNa) suvihatan'ti pasāretvā suṭṭhu vihataṃ. ūnakasatasaṅkuvihatañ'hi nibbalikaṃ na hoti, saṅkusatena vihataṃ bheritalaṃ viya nibbalikaṃ hoti. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ, evam'eva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, mahānāma, sukhettaṃ subhūmaṃ suvihatakhāṇukaṃ, bījāni c'assu akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avāt'ātapahatāni sār'ādāni sukhasayitāni, devo ca sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya. api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun'ti?

64633.meaning1: well cleared of stumps and thorns

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha sukhette subhūme suvihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhapeyya akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avāt'ātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni. devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

64635.commentary: (VINa) suvītan'ti suṭṭhu vītaṃ, sabbaṭṭhānesu samaṃ katvā vītaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha
evaṃ bhaddantavā'ti kho, bhikkhave, suvīro devaputto sakkassa devānam'indassa paṭissutvā tatiyam'pi pamādaṃ āpādesi.

64638.construction:
su + √vass > vuss + ti + ikā
suvuṭṭhi + ikā
64638.commentary: (DNa) suvuṭṭhikā'ti devassa sammādhār'ānuppavecchanaṃ. dubbuṭṭhikā'ti avaggāho, vassavibandho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, suvuṭṭhikā bhavissati, dubbuṭṭhikā bhavissati, subhikkhaṃ bhavissati, dubbhikkhaṃ bhavissati
sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.

yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe ubhato vacīsaṃsāro diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi ajjhattaṃ suvūpasantaṃ hoti, tasm'etaṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca phāsuṃ viharissantī'ti.

64641.meaning1: easy to calm; easy to settle

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
ajj'eva kiccam'ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.

64644.commentary: (MNa) suveḷuvane'ti suveḷu nāma ekā rukkhajāti, tehi sañchanno mahāvanasaṇḍo, tattha viharati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gajaṅgalāyaṃ viharati suveḷuvane. atha kho uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
kodhasammadasammatto, āyasakyaṃ nigacchati, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, parivajjanti kodhanaṃ.
atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.
honti h'ete, sāriputta, channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulāni.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.
evañ'hi sā yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā. atha sattamo puriso āgaccheyya byābhaṅgihattho.

64650.meaning1: well killed; rightly executed; murdered properly; completely dead

examples.text: so hi nūna, bhante, suhato hoti, yaṃ na tathāgato vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññati, n'āpi viññū sabrahmacārī vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.

64651.meaning1: even more well beaten; more thoroughly thrashed

examples.text: atha sattamo puriso āgaccheyya byābhaṅgihattho. so taṃ yavakalāpiṃ sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haneyya. evañ'hi sā bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatatarā assa, sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haññamānā.
sace so, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano āyatiṃ punabbhavāya ceteti, evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, moghapuriso suhatataro hoti, seyyathā'pi sā yavakalāpī sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haññamānā.
cattāro'me, gahapatiputta, mittā suhadā veditabbā. upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo, samānasukhadukkho mitto suhado veditabbo, atth'akkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo, anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo.

64656.meaning1: satiated; satisfied; full (with food or drink)

examples.text: allaṃ sukkhaṃ vā bhuñjanto, na bāḷhaṃ suhito siyā, ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, sato bhikkhu paribbaje.
idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhuttāvī assaṃ pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāva'd'attho, siyā ca me piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍanīyadhammo
karaṇīyam'atthakusalena, yaṃ taṃ santaṃ padaṃ abhisamecca, sakko ujū ca suhujū ca, suvaco c'assa mudu anatimānī.

64658.commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

examples.text: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suhuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.

64659.meaning1: (of an oblation) properly offered; well sacrificed

examples.text: addhā suyiṭṭhaṃ suhutaṃ mama y'idaṃ, yaṃ tādisaṃ vedagum'addasāmi, tumhādisānañ'hi adassanena, añño jano bhuñjati habyasesan'ti.

ahiṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. suṃsumāraṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. pakkhiṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. kukkuraṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. siṅgālaṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. makkaṭaṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.

64662.meaning1: name of the capital city of Bhagga
64662.commentary: (MNa) tassa kira nagarassa vatthupariggahadivase avidūre udakarahade suṃsumāro saddam'akāsi, giraṃ nicchāresi. atha nagare niṭṭhite suṃsumāragiraṃ tv'ev'assa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye. tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi, āvuso, bhikkhavo'ti.

mā ca vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi. vaṇ'ānurakkhī ca, ambho purisa, vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī'ti.

64665.meaning1: (of a plant) hair; bristle; spike; spicule
64665.commentary: (ANa) sālisūkan'ti sāliphalassa sūkaṃ. yavasūke'pi es'eva nayo. (SNt) sūkan'ti sāli-yav'ādīnaṃ vālam'āha. so hi nikantakasadiso paṭimukhagataṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhindati, tasmā bhedaṃ icchantena uddhaggaṃ katvā ṭhapitaṃ sammāpaṇihitaṃ nāma, tathā aṭṭhapitaṃ micchāpaṇihitaṃ nāmā'ti vuttaṃ.

64668.meaning2: Chapter 6 of the Indriyasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

64669.commentary: (MNa) sūkarakhatāyan'ti sūkarakhatā'ti evaṃnāmake leṇe. kassapabuddhakāle kira taṃ leṇaṃ ekasmiṃ buddh'antare pathaviyā vaḍḍhamānāya antobhūmigataṃ jātaṃ. ath'ekadivasaṃ eko sūkaro tassa chadanapariyantasamīpe paṃsuṃ khaṇi. deve vuṭṭe paṃsudhoto chadanapariyanto pākaṭo ahosi. eko vanacarako disvā, pubbe sīlavantehi paribhuttaleṇena bhavitabbaṃ, paṭijaggissāmi nan'ti samantato paṃsuṃ apanetvā leṇaṃ sodhetvā kuṭṭaparikkhepaṃ katvā dvāravātapānaṃ yojetvā supariniṭṭhita-sudhākamma-cittakamma-rajatapaṭṭa-sadisāya vālukāya santhatapariveṇaṃ leṇaṃ katvā mañcapīṭhaṃ paññāpetvā bhagavato vasan'atthāya adāsi. leṇaṃ gambhīraṃ ahosi otaritvā abhiruhitabbaṃ. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate sūkarakhatāyaṃ. atha kho dīghanakho paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.

64672.commentary: (VINa) sūkar'antakaṃ nāma kuñjik'ākosakasaṇṭhānaṃ hoti. ekarajjukaṃ pana muddikakāyabandhanañ'ca sūkar'antakaṃ anulometi.

examples.text: kāyabandhanaṃ nāma dve kāyabandhanāni, paṭṭikā, sūkar'antakaṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññataro sūkaraposako puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ agamāsi. tattha addasa pahūtaṃ sukkhagūthaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ.

64675.commentary: (DNa) mama ca sūkarabhattan'ti mama ca sūkarānaṃ idaṃ bhattaṃ.

examples.text: disvān'assa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho pahuto sukkhagūtho chaḍḍito, mama ca sūkarabhattaṃ, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ ito sukkhagūthaṃ hareyyan'ti.

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mahiṃsānaṃ sataṃ mahiṃsabhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ … dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, urabbhānaṃ sataṃ urabbhabhūtānaṃ … ajānaṃ sataṃ ajabhūtānaṃ… migānaṃ sataṃ migabhūtānaṃ… kukkuṭānaṃ sataṃ kukkuṭabhūtānaṃ… sūkarānaṃ sataṃ sūkarabhūtānaṃ…

64677.commentary: (DNa) sūkaramaddavan'ti n'ātitaruṇassa n'ātijiṇṇassa ekajeṭṭhakasūkarassa pavattamaṃsaṃ. taṃ kira mudu c'eva siniddhañ'ca hoti, taṃ paṭiyādāpetvā sādhukaṃ pacāpetvā'ti attho. eke bhaṇanti, sūkaramaddavan'ti pana mudu-odanassa pañcagorasa-yūsapācana-vidhānassa nām'etaṃ, yathā gavapānaṃ nāma pākanāman'ti. (UDa) sūkaramaddavan'ti sūkarassa mudusiniddhaṃ pavattamaṃsan'ti mahā-aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ. keci pana sūkaramaddavan'ti na sūkaramaṃsaṃ, sūkarehi madditavaṃsakaḷīro'ti vadanti. aññe sūkarehi madditappadese jātaṃ ahichattakan'ti. apare pana sūkaramaddavaṃ nāma ekaṃ rasāyanan'ti bhaṇiṃsu. tañ'hi cundo kammāraputto ajja bhagavā parinibbāyissatī'ti sutvā app'eva nāma naṃ paribhuñjitvā cirataraṃ tiṭṭheyyā'ti satthu cirajīvitu'kamyatāya adāsī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato paṭissutvā yaṃ ahosi sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇitvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, viriccamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.

64678.commentary: (ANa) sūkaramaṃsan'ti madhurarasehi badarehi saddhiṃ jīrak'ādisambhārehi yojetvā pakkaṃ ekasaṃvaccharika-sūkaramaṃsaṃ. nibbattatelakan'ti vinivattitatelaṃ.

examples.text: sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, sampannakolakaṃ sūkaramaṃsaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
akappiyena āsādetī'ti acchamaṃsaṃ sūkaramaṃsan'ti, dīpimaṃsaṃ vā migamaṃsan'ti khādāpetvā, tvaṃ kiṃ samaṇo nāma, akappiyamaṃsaṃ te khāditan'ti ghaṭṭeti.

64680.meaning1: pig farmer; boar hunter; (comm) pig butcher
64680.commentary: (ANa) urabbhe hanatī'ti orabbhiko. sūkarik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. (THIa) sūkarikā'ti sūkaraghātakā.

examples.text: orabbhikā sūkarikā, macchikā migabandhakā, corā ca vajjhaghātā ca, ye c'aññe pāpakammino, dak'ābhisecanā te'pi, pāpakammā pamuccare.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti sūkariko sākuṇiko māgaviko luddo macchaghātako coro coraghātako goghātako bandhan'āgāriko, ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci kurūrakamm'antā.

64683.meaning1: (of a plant) hair; bristle; spike; spicule

examples.text: balaṃ bījañ'ca nāgo ca, rukkho kumbhena sūkiyā, ākāsena ca dve meghā, nāvā āgantukā nadī'ti.

64684.commentary: (SNa) sūcako'ti pesuññakārako. so kira manusse aññam'aññañ'ca bhindi, rājakule ca imassa imaṃ nāma atthi, iminā idaṃ nāma katan'ti sūcetvā sūcetvā anayabyasanaṃ pāpesi. tasmā yathā tena sūcetvā manussā bhinnā, tathā sūcīhi bhedanadukkhaṃ paccanubhotuṃ kammam'eva nimittaṃ katvā sūcilomapeto jāto.

examples.text: ye pāpasīlā iṇaghātasūcakā, vohārakūṭā idha pāṭirūpikā, nar'ādhamā ye'dha karonti kibbisaṃ, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, kiṃ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, ahaṃ sūcivāṇijako, tvaṃ sūcikāro, udāhu ahaṃ sūcikāro, tvaṃ sūcivāṇijako'ti?
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso has'āpekkho'pi, pācittiyaṃ.
sovaṇṇamayāya vedikāya sovaṇṇamayā thambhā ahesuṃ, rūpiyamayā sūciyo ca uṇhīsañ'ca.

64691.commentary: (THIa) koccha-sūci-vicit'agga-sobhitan'ti pubbe kocchena suvaṇṇasūciyā ca kesajaṭāvijaṭanena vicit'aggaṃ hutvā sobhitaṃ, ghanabhāvena vā kocchasadisaṃ hutvā paṇadantasūcīhi vicit'aggatāya sobhitaṃ.

examples.text: kānanaṃ'va sahitaṃ suropitaṃ, koccha-sūci-vicit'agga-sobhitaṃ, taṃ jarāya viralaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, kiṃ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, ahaṃ sūcivāṇijako, tvaṃ sūcikāro, udāhu ahaṃ sūcikāro, tvaṃ sūcivāṇijako'ti?

64696.meaning1: having closed the bolt; having locked the door
64696.commentary: (UDa) sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā'ti aggaḷasūciñ'ca uparighaṭikañ'ca ādahitvā, suṭṭhutaraṃ kavāṭaṃ thaketvā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami

atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷ'antarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi.

64697.commentary: (UDa) sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā'ti aggaḷasūciñ'ca uparighaṭikañ'ca ādahitvā, suṭṭhutaraṃ kavāṭaṃ thaketvā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami

atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷ'antarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso has'āpekkho'pi, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu aṭṭhimayaṃ vā dantamayaṃ vā visāṇamayaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ kārāpeyya, bhedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
